nature: Exploratory retrospective matched-information study specified after inspecting the original test records; not confirmatory or preregistered
question: At identical seismic-grade allocations, does adding monitoring variables to three hazard assessments and shift type increase expected hazardous-shift detections?
extended_features: The existing ordered 17-column design; nbumps remains excluded, constant columns retained
cohorts: Four existing Stage 2 time folds only; exact fitting/test rows from saved fold_manifest.json; no holdout; policy reference excluded from all fitting and tuning
tuning: Each design independently selects one of the same four configurations by AP on the same temporal inner split; negative Brier if no inner positives; first grid entry on exact ties; no budget-specific tuning
allocation: Within each phase K=floor(B*N); higher seismic grade first; identical grade quotas for both models. Pooled counts sum phase allocations and never mix model scores across phases.
score_ties: Exact score equality within seismic grade. Include complete higher-score groups; distribute remaining h slots uniformly within a boundary group of m records. Report analytic inclusion probabilities and E(TP)=h*p/m for that group for BOTH models. No random tie seed or label-directed allocation.
primary_contrast: Extended E(TP) minus base E(TP); positive favors added monitoring under this fitting and allocation workflow

bootstrap.seed_rule: seed + 1000*block_length + fold; independent within-phase nonwrapping moving-block draws. The same counts feed both designs and every budget; pooled replicates sum matched phase replicates.
bootstrap.operation: Freeze fitted models and tuning choices; reconstruct each sampled multiset, recompute K and grade quotas, rerank and analytically evaluate score ties. Retain zero-positive samples.

interval_scope: Unadjusted conditional 95% percentile intervals; no full fitting/tuning/selection or operational-dispatch uncertainty. Block lengths measure record-order sensitivity, not known physical durations.
loss_identity: At fixed P and K, E(L)=r*P+K-(r+1)*E(TP). Cost contrasts are algebraic consequences, not independent outcomes. No new cost grid.
output_scope: A separate protocol, phase-specific results table, increment/interval figure and short discussion, with machine-readable scores/models/tuning/row inclusion probabilities/bootstrap evidence and separate calculation/replay checks. Original two-stage papers and pilot evidence remain unchanged.
no_test_selection: Retain every phase, budget and block length; do not choose features, models, configurations, a budget or a block length from test outcomes.
